ev.q: Wartales is a tactical role-playing game developed by Shiro Games
Players manage a mercenary band as it attempts to survive
There are elements of survival games, where characters gather necessary resources
a low fantasy world that is trying to recover from a plague
a medieval land suffers shortages and banditry
The game has an open world in which players traverse an overworld map
Wartales is a tactical role-playing game with sandbox gameplay
praised its emergent gameplay and ability to create interesting anecdotes
Wartales is a deep and richly rewarding exercise in party creation
